summary: An Etobicoke hygiene clinic appears to lose new clients to a yahoo contact and no online booking.

findings.problem: The only email shown appears to be a yahoo.ca address.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust, and it can land in spam when clients write to you.
findings.fix: A clinic email on your own domain.

findings.problem: No online booking link appears in the menu, only Contact.
findings.cost: Clients who want to book at night cannot, and they book where they can.

findings.problem: No text or WhatsApp option appears next to the phone number.
findings.cost: Clients who want a quick answer message first.
